title: ID0409885-DC/Si-D/FR[170001862] - Converter E32
description:
Reported behaviour/issue:
Converter not found, CanCommLoss
Solution:
Loose wiring
Converter Error 32 → Critical → Repair needed = Yes → Discharge circuit error
